LESSON: WRITING 7.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING: POETRY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Writing 7.3.1 Creative Writing: Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 7.3.1 Creative Writing: Poetry, part of Strand 7 in Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How is poetry important in our daily life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch and listen to audio recording on simple poems,

2. identify features of a poem from the audio recording,

3. compose simple poems based on the theme and write using neat and legible handwriting,

4. recite the poems fluently and do a peer review collaboratively,

5. record their poem recitations using digital devices,

6. organise their neatly written poems and recorded versions in the class portfolio.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch and listen to audio recording on simple poems,
2. identify features of a poem from the audio recording,
3. compose simple poems based on the theme and write using neat and legible handwriting,
4. recite the poems fluently and do a peer review collaboratively,
5. record their poem recitations using digital devices,
6. organise their neatly written poems and recorded versions in the class portfolio.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 7.3.1 Creative Writing: Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with technology as they record their poem recitations using digital

devices.

• Creativity and Imagination: This is cultivated as the learner composes simple poems in neat and legible handwriting.

42

Values:
• Unity: This is enhanced as the learner works harmoniously with peers to create simple poems based on the theme.

• Respect: This is promoted as the learner accommodates diverse opinions given by others during peer review sessions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

ICT: This is promoted as the learner manipulates digital devices to record themselves reciting poems and interacts with digital

content from the audio recordings.

Link to other Learning Areas:
